ceiling_directive: Either add explicit interior-slack conditions for the Hölder, bounded-response, and two-sided-modulus envelopes, or construct all lower-bound pairs under the currently allowed boundary-tight constants.
improvement_directive: Repair the beta-mixing and iid lower embeddings so their carrier-plus-bump alternatives remain in every stated nonempty class, including cases such as c_mod = C_mod and saturated Hölder or outcome envelopes. Alternatively, state primitive uniform slack conditions and propagate them through both risk and honest-length frontier theorems.
critique: The note advertises sharp four-channel minimax and honest-length frontiers for every fixed nonempty strict-donor-slack class, but its lower-bound embeddings do not establish that quantifier. The proofs repeatedly assert that carrier-plus-bump perturbations can be scaled to preserve the Hölder, bounded-response, and two-sided-modulus envelopes, although nonemptiness and B>D^2 provide no interior slack in those envelopes; for example, c_mod=C_mod is allowed. Consequently the upper rates, exact conditional coverage, and original-class obstruction are delivered, while the matching spacing and related converses—and therefore the advertised sharp dependence elbow on the stated classes—remain unproved. The absence of a calibrated financial example supporting event transport and the two strong full-design centering restrictions further limits the projected leading-journal score.
